description: ANP publishes exploration and production information through linked tables and queries, including active and completed wells, hydrocarbon indications, well outcomes, blocks and commerciality declarations. The provider is Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis. Coverage: Coverage is Brazil. The landing page was updated in June 2026; individual tables may cover different periods and their spatial precision is not stated here. Access: ANP provides public links to tables and queries. Only the describing page was read; payload formats and completeness were not inspected. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: A hydrocarbon indication is not evidence of commercial reserves. Declarations reflect operator assessments and require their individual dates and conditions to be retained. For simulation it supplies source routes for upstream oil and gas assets, development status and resource scenarios. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
